Weekly Variant Challenge: Summer Vibes Theme – Win a Season Pass!

  • CanadianAlfredo
  • Updated: August 11, 2026
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:51
Instaread

Welcome Snappers to the weekly variant challenge! Each week, I want YOU to submit your favorite variants and splits you have for a chance to win a Premium Season Pass! If you already have a pass for the current season, I will give you a Season Pass for next season when it arrives! The winner will also get to be the judge for the following week’s challenge!

Before getting to the challenge for this week, here is the winner of last week’s Summer Vibes Variant challenge! The winner was crowned by last week’s runner-up, Melevorn! And the winner is…

Congratulations! Message me on discord or Reddit to claim your prize!

Now for 2nd place, you have won the chance to judge the upcoming challenge, as well as pick the next theme we do! And the runner up is…

As mentioned above, message me on discord or Reddit to claim your prize!

Now let’s check out some other entries from the community from last week! If you just want to see the next challenge, scroll to the bottom for all the details.

Next Week’s Challenge: Noir / Horror Theme!

This week’s judge, Melevorn, has selected your next variant challenge: Noir and Horror! Time for those nitty-gritty variants to get the spotlight. Send in your best variant / split of the strange, dark, and mysterious! It doesn’t have to be literally noir or horror directly, but it should have that same feeling.

Next week, 2nd place gets to judge the upcoming challenge, as well as pick the next theme!

Here are a couple of quick rules for entry:

  • Only 1 variant submission per player, per week.
  • You can submit your entry to our MSZ Discord page under “variant submissions”, or directly in the comments on this page!
  • Variants MUST be submitted by the deadline in order to be counted in the current week’s challenge.
  • If you don’t want a season pass for this (or next) season, simply add “not competing” to your entry. I will happily feature variants next week from any of you who just want to show off their cool splits (just try to stay on theme).

Submissions start now and run until Sunday at 11:59 PM EST. Below is a timer to help measure your remaining time. A winner will be announced on the following Tuesday, and a new challenge will begin!

3Days16Hours54Minutes56Seconds

I just want to take a moment to thank you all for entering every week! It has been a blast hosting every week, and even more fun looking at all of your variants (and yes, I look at every single entry like the judge does!) Thank you for reading and participating to make this possible each week!

Good luck to everyone, and Happy Snapping, and I’ll be looking forward to seeing your next entries!
